title: Pope Lando (121º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: Subject and later the sovereign of the Papal States. Last to use a new and non-composed regnal name until Francis(2013–2025).

title: Pope John X (122º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: Subject and later the sovereign of the Papal States.

title: Pope Leo VI LEO Sextus (123º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: Subject and later the sovereign of the Papal States.

title: Pope Stephen VII (124º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: Subject and later the sovereign of the Papal States. Sometimes called Stephen VIII.

title: Pope John XI (125º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: Subject and later the sovereign of the Papal States. Probably, according to the Liber Pontificalis and Liutprand of Cremona, the son of Sergius III, who was Marozia's husband, and not of Alberic I of Spoleto.

title: Pope Leo VII LEO Septimus (126º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: Subject and later the sovereign of the Papal States. Member of the Order of Saint Benedict.

title: Pope Stephen VIII (127º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: Subject and later the sovereign of the Papal States. Sometimes called Stephen IX.

title: Pope Marinus II (128º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: Subject and later the sovereign of the Papal States. Erroneously also known as Martin III.

title: Pope Agapetus II (129º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: Subject and later the sovereign of the Papal States.

title: Pope John XII (130º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: Subject and later the sovereign of the Papal States. Possibly murdered in 964. End of the Saeculum obscurum.

title: Pope Benedict V (131º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: Subject and later the sovereign of the Papal States. Elected by the people of Rome in opposition to Leo VIII, who was appointed by Emperor Otto I. Accepted his deposition in favour of Leo VIII in 964.

title: Pope Leo VIII LEO Octavus (132º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: Subject and later the sovereign of the Papal States. His pontificate after the deposition of Benedict V is considered legitimate by today's Catholic Church.

title: Pope John XIII (133º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: Subject and later the sovereign of the Papal States. Chronicled after his death as "the Good".

title: Pope Benedict VI (134º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: Subject and later the sovereign of the Papal States. Was of Lombard ethnicity. Deposed and murdered.

title: Pope Benedict VII (135º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: Subject and later the sovereign of the Papal States.

title: Pope John XIV (136º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: Subject of the Kingdom of Italy. Fourth pope not to use his personal name (Pietro Canepanova).

title: Pope John XV (137º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: Subject and later the sovereign of the Papal States. First pope to formally canonize a saint.

title: Pope Gregory V (138º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: Subject of the Duchy of Carinthia. First official German pope. Fifth pope not to use his personal name (Bruno). Henceforth, this decision became tradition among the future popes.

title: Pope Sylvester II (139º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: Subject of the Kingdom of the West Franks(later renamed Kingdom of France). First French(Occitan) pope. Member of the Order of Saint Benedict.

title: Pope John XVII (140º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: Subject and later the sovereign of the Papal States.

title: Pope John (141º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: Subject and later the sovereign of the Papal States. First pope born after the Papal States became a state of the Holy Roman Empire in 962.

title: Pope Sergius IV (142º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: Subject and later the sovereign of the Papal States. Member of the Order of Saint Benedict.

title: Pope Benedict VIII (143º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: Subject and later the sovereign of the Papal States. Brother of John XIX.

title: Pope John XIX (144º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: Subject and later the sovereign of the Papal States. Brother of Benedict VIII.

title: Pope Benedict IX (145º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: Subject and later the sovereign of the Papal States. First term; youngest person to have been pope.

title: Pope Sylvester III (146º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: Subject and later the sovereign of the Papal States. Validity of his election questioned; deposed at the Council of Sutri.

title: Pope Benedict IX (147º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: Subject and later the sovereign of the Papal States. Second term; deposed at the Council of Sutri.

title: Pope Gregory VI (148º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: Subject and later the sovereign of the Papal States. Deposed at the Council of Sutri.

title: Pope Clement II (149º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: Subject of the Duchy of Saxony. Appointed by King Henry III at the Council of Sutri; crowned Emperor Henry III in 1046.

title: Pope Benedict IX (150º): Biography, Pontificate & Legacy
sourceNotes: Subject and later the sovereign of the Papal States. Third term; deposed and excommunicated.
